details: calculator-preinstall-hook-demo@1.1.2 presents itself as a test fixture for npm lifecycle hooks. Its preinstall script runs `node preinstall.js` on npm install, which POSTs the machine's hostname and the OS username to the Discord webhook `https://discord.com/api/webhooks/1566215853794394162/xsqpEbSn-cc3DU2AKWdzqWnXX5hjTfV-gUePQZ4evrHGlZctMd40TKCrN42qnJd7moc1`. It was published by the npm account bigdevin55 together with calculator-preinstall-chain-demo@1.1.2, which pulls it in as a dependency.
